name: Cardboard and tape
one_line: Box buildings, masking tape and marker pen on a workbench.
look_words: A world built by a child from boxes. Raw brown corrugated cardboard for the ground and walls, paler board and strips of masking tape for paths and joins, windows cut out with scissors, details drawn in black marker. Edges are torn or wobbly, the corrugation shows, and things are held up with tape, string and lolly sticks. Light is warm daylight from one side of a workbench. A few patches of poster paint do the signalling: teal and lime green for the things that matter, red for harm, and the player is painted dark blue. Motion is stiff and hinged: flaps, sliding tabs, things on strings. Avoid clean geometry, smooth plastic, gradients, glow and bloom.

palette.name: cardboard
palette.notes: Nearly everything is brown, so the three paints carry all the meaning. Keep paint off scenery.

look_wish: marker outlines on textured board, tilt-shift blur

upgrade.why: makes it look like a real model on a workbench
wobbly pen lines for the marker details

music.mood: toy piano, shakers and a cardboard-box drum

sound_feel: cardboard thumps, tape ripping, scissors, a marker squeak
